Prince of Persia HWLev03 is a Custom set of level based on the original DOS Prince of Persia game. This mod contains 13 custom levels created by hanswurst but the intent of the mod is to improve graphics, so very little has been changed other than improved graphics, especially when standing still. This mod was originally created for the Dos version and converted to the C64 by Starwindz and released in the Prince of Persia Total Pack.

210386.overview:
It is a time of darkness. While the Sultan is off fighting a foreign war, his Grand Vizier Jaffar has seized the reins of power. Throughout the land, the people groan under the yoke of tyranny, and dream of better days.
You are the only obstacle between Jaffar and the throne. An adventurer from a foreign land, innocent of palace intrigues, you have won the heart of the Sultan's lovely daughter. And in so doing, you have unwittingly made a powerful enemy.
On Jaffar's orders, you are arrested, stripped of your sword and possessions, and thrown into the Sultan's dungeons.

Prince of Persia Seeking Revenge is a Custom set of level based on the original DOS Prince of Persia game. It contains 13 custom levels. This mod was originally created by ConaZ for the Dos version and converted to the C64 by Starwindz and released in the Prince of Persia Total Pack.

210623.overview:
Prince of Persia Alternate 1 is a Custom set of level based on the original DOS Prince of Persia game. It contains 13 custom levels modified from the original game. This mod was originally created for the Dos version by dspprince and converted to the C64 by Starwindz and released in the Prince of Persia Total Pack.It is in some ways less difficult than most mods, intended to be like a fighting tower game. 
 
It is a time of darkness. While the Sultan is off fighting a foreign war, his Grand Vizier Jaffar has seized the reins of power. Throughout the land, the people groan under the yoke of tyranny, and dream of better days. You are the only obstacle between Jaffar and the throne. An adventurer from a foreign land, innocent of palace intrigues, you have won the heart of the Sultan's lovely daughter. And in so doing, you have unwittingly made a powerful enemy. On Jaffar's orders, you are arrested, stripped of your sword and possessions, and thrown into the Sultan's dungeons. Escape and save the kingdom.

212308.overview:
Peg Board is a peg solitaire game for the Commodore 64. It was developed by John R. Olsen and published in the following:

-   RUN 1987/08 (Issue #44)
-   RUN Strategy Pack II

212525.overview: Not to be confused by the Amiga Shooter of the same name (or the completely unrelated shooter of the same name on the SNES), Phalanx on the Commodore 64 is a German language single-player version of the standard 4-in-a-row game (like Connect 4). This game was developed by Daniel Durstewitz & Waldemar Raaz and published in Computer Kontakt 1985/01.

212541.overview:
Peter is a French language "catch-it" game for the Commodore 64. 

This game was developed by Manfredi Dominico and published in the following:

-   Hebdogiciel N°138 (06.06.1986) 
-   Hebdogiciel N°139 (13.06.1986)

In the game, you play the titular character who has to look after an egg farm all on his own. The goal of the game is to catch the eggs laid by three hens situated at the top of the screen. Not as easy as it looks. Peter has to catch up with the help of a pole, the eggs that hens on a perch lay despite common sense. Woe to our friend if one of the eggs touches the ground.

212936.overview:
Pac-Man 64 is a faithful clone (gameplay wise) of the arcade classic of the same name for the Commodore 64. It was developed by Nick Sherman (aka Arlasoft) and published on his itch.io page on April 30, 2022.

It does take some liberties with the playing field, as it uses scrolling rather than having the entire playing field on the screen at the same time. That's primarily due to the limitations of the C64 hardware.

How To Play:

-   Move around the maze using joystick, avoiding the ghosts and collecting all the pellets. 


-   Collect the flashing power pellets to turn the tables. Now for a brief period you can eat the frightened ghost that have turned blue. Eat all four for the maximum bonus.


-   Hold a direction just before a turn to 'slide' round corners and gain a speed advantage over chasing ghosts


-   Go through the tunnel on the edge of the map to lose a chasing ghost, as they slow down when moving through them.

213291.overview:
From The New Dimension comes this weird an wacky PONG game, written specially for the PONG 50th Anniversary Game Jam run by Retro Programmers Inside (a private FB user group) and Phaze101. This game is a pong clone, but much weirder. The game was 95% developed on theC64 full size computer It contains the following features:

- Compatible on PAL and NTSC C64s
- Enhanced graphics, with really nice background tile animation
- Up-tempo in game sound track or self-programmed sound effects
- Fully presentable with a selection of in game options
- Compatible with VICE, Ultimate,  and theC64 (theC64 mini users might need a keyboard for selecting in game options).
- 64TASS Complete source code complete with program data provided
(You will need 64TASS and Exomizer and VICE, also rename build.txt to build.bat and edit the file with the correct path for building

A game for one or two players in which you use a racket to hit the ball back to your opponent, hoping they won’t return it, thereby scoring a point. Before the game begins, you can, amongst other things, choose the number of points needed to win the match. In the centre of the court, an alien moves vertically, altering the trajectory of the bouncing ball and periodically unleashing various pleasant or unpleasant surprises.

215970.overview:
A German language "complete" chess program aka Profi Chess released in 1987 by Falken Verlag GmbH and Ariolasoft. "Das komplette Schach-programm" was developed with the intention of taking chess programming into a new direction. It is designed not only for the beginner, who would like to play against an appropriate chess partner, but also for the hobby player, who wants to systematically increase his play strength and become acquainted with the reasons behind the play. Also, the advanced amateur, who would like to sharpen his training on combinations, finds an instructor, with an ideal game interference with many options in the open structure of the program.

In the "Spielen" (Play) section, heavy emphasis is made on opening variations that can be practiced, by allowing the player to study the opening library that is available on the disk. In the program section " Trainieren" (Training) short lessons are available to the user, as well as stored diagram test positions all created to increase your chess knowledge, in all three stages of the game -- Opening, middle and endgame.

The program plays strictly according to the international chess rules, possesses a problem solving function, which solves up to mate-in-nine chess problems. A “Save Game” is also available and the program recognizes and names the twenty most important chess openings.

216336.overview:
The goal is to remove as many scribes as possible from the board by jumping over one scribe at a time into an empty space.
If a pharaoh is jumped, that is considered an overthrow. Keep in mind that the fewer overthrows you have the better your rating will be, should you win the game. This game by Alan Gardner was published in both Loadstar #026 and the Best of Loadstar #3.

216389.overview: A selectable answers text adventure from Frank Seferlis, known as P.World II or Pleasure World 2. It is as you would expect a sequel to the original P.World that was released earlier that year. Understandably there is (im)mature language involved.

216390.overview:
A homebrew Space Invaders style shoot'em up by Reed Byers aka Unbeliever. Released with source with excellent comments if you are interested in learning some assembly language. It's basically just a shooting gallery, nothing special.  One row of targets that simply moves back and forth til you shoot them all, then they start a row closer, and faster.  After five rows of the same enemy, you start a new "wave" of five rows, with a new enemy.  After four waves, you start back with the first wave.  Your only score is your hit/miss ratio, and your enemies can't shoot back.  If you want to take a break, just walk away from the game; the enemies will be happy to wander back and forth until you're ready to shoot them some more.

Every single sprite is animated; even your shot.  Every enemy type has its own explosion shape.  There are simple sound effects for shooting, and explosions.

216391.overview: What would you get if you put Pac-Man and Wizard of Wor in a blender with a side of Krisztián Tóth (Krissz). You'd get this 2-player only 2021 hybrid PD game. This looks to be a good Arcade homage for those of you who remember the classic from 1982. As not only does it have all the dot chomping goodness you could want in a Pac-Man Arcade game, but unlike the original Arcade game, in this one the Ghosts have been replaced by Burwors from Wizard of Wor, and each one when eaten after gobbling up a big pellet gives you points depending on the Burwor being eaten.

216392.overview: This Pacman reimagined game has some groovy music by Timur Baysal, at least, but seems bugged as when you collect the last power pill/seed on the level then you sometimes immediately lose a life, however it can be finished by leaving those alone. This game was published by Paradize Software in 1994.

216393.overview:
A single player Italian language action game, published in Crown Games n.5. Our character finds himself in a labyrinth full of dangers, but in this labyrinth there are precious energy pills that make his pacemaker work.

An unofficial English translated version was released the same year by the cracking group, Hokuto Force.

216394.overview: A Sierra On-Line game for the C64, this isn't your average Pac-Man clone. It uses the Commodore "3D" Labyrinth code and has you in something of a first person view of running through the maze and grabbing the dots that look like pucks from this view. Watch out for the ghosts, they are after you. You can see a small representation of the map on the bottom right to help you keep your orientation.

216395.overview: A single player horizontally scrolling shooter intended to be a conversion from a coin op game. Go for the burn with the toughest, roughest ride in town.

216396.overview:
A puzzle game made by Sascha Brauner in 1994 and eventually published in both 64'er 1996/05, and in 64'er Top-Spiele #6. Life is a mixture of puzzles, action and hustle and bustle, but here you build complex structures that the C 64 specifies in no time at all. If you spell "Perfect Symmetry," you have to get a good dose of hectic, the goal of the game is to reproduce the objects on the right side of the game true to the original in the game field. It starts out very easy. But be careful, some things will pop up that will challenge you, but there is always only one solution, so keep your eyes open! Tip: always pay attention to the dot grid. Here you can see off which stone was actually set in the original. Once all three Levels done, you can count on a little surprise.  
 
Extras can also provide a lot of help in a thinking game, Bel Perfect Symmetry there are six. These extras are shown as small loon in the lower edge. Whenever you have completed a level and there are still more than 30 seconds left on the time account. you can enjoy a special weapon. One scrolls the tiles at twice the speed. This makes it available to set the element. The second is a preview function, so it allows you to take a look at the next stone before the current one is placed. Once level three has been reached, the goal stays difficult. Extra number four contains three different bonuses that fall from the ceiling: for example, you can increase your score by ten points, get an extra minute of time or jump straight to the next level In order to get the bonus, it must fall directly on the vehicle.

216398.overview: Phong! is a Pong clone for 2-4 players.  It was developed by Joel Ricci on code and Univerz on graphics. The game requires paddle controllers.

216400.overview: A pinball action game from 21st Century Entertainment and published in GO64! 2005/03.

216401.overview: Pirates of Dark Waters is a pirate themed text adventure for the Commodore 64. It was developed by Binary Legends and published in Loadstar #249.

216402.overview: A multi-scrolling, single player shooter created by David Husch. In the game you pilot a tank and must gather up all the humans while fending off fearsome spider creatures and other tanks with daunting homing missiles. Take them out and the factory that produces them. When you've reduced the amount of baddies the mothership will come take you to the next area plagued by foes.

216403.overview: A SEUCK based shooter for one or two simultaneous players, the primary author is unknown but Jim Butterfield did the music. A surreal mix between Dadaistic imagery and your standard shoot'em up.

216404.overview:
This is Polar Present Panic - A free Christmas game for the Commodore 64 computer! Due to illness I didn't quite get it how I wanted it before Xmas but was determined to release before Xmas day! There will be an update in the next week or so adding the missing graphical elements.

Santa is trying to get all his presents ready to deliver but a group of evil rogue elves is trying to sabotage him and sneak deadly evil presents on to the production line! You must let all the green presents through the barrier but stop any red presents or snow balls that the evil elves send your way!

If you break a good present, or let a bad red present or snowball through then the temperature of the present packing machine will increase. If this gets too hot then it is game over!

216405.overview: A two player only pong game released in the Ludum Dare #26 challenge whose theme was minimalism. The game was made by Mikolaj Kaminski for Ludum Dare #26 happened in 2013.

216406.overview: A horizontally scrolling shooter released by Slimesoft in 1987. Avoid the missiles shooting straight up and keep your fuel levels up in the Skramble style shooter.

216407.overview: An on-field arcade style football\soccer game from Grandslam Entertainment.

216408.overview: A one or two player shooter, created by Pixol & Hawk-I using the Shoot'em up Construction Kit in 1991. It is the sequel to Probe-X - Planet Osmium. It supports cooperative play.

216409.overview: we are on a journey to discover worlds unknown ... let's go on a reconnaissance in space and get out of our mothership "Fly20" ... with your spaceship "Project - x9" spent a while in space we suddenly approach some steroids ... and some strange flying objects... ...platforms appearing in front of us ... of which not we know the origin ...... "Here --- X9 a mothership,,,I see alien spaceships approaching the our airship ...! "... defend your mothership and destroy whoever commands the aliens ... the battle looms !!!

216411.overview: A 15-puzzle game with 3x3,4x4,5x5, and 6x6 puzzle pieces field. Push the buttons to bring the numbers in order. Playable with joystick or mouse. Features Win95 style menus, dialogs, and buttons.

216413.overview:
"Go on an adventurous search for these legendary podcasters and find their secret base."

Already as a kid I've always wanted to know how my C64 games work. I did those BASIC programs in the user's manual and were happy about that now famous  Commodore balloon. But I read in the magazines that the C64 BASIC was crappy and not suitable for games and that the good games are done in assembly.

But as a young non-english speaker and without the internet I didn't find the right resources to teach myself assembly language.

Later I lost my interest in the C64 (and even my Amiga...), had a job and had to do other stuff.

Some time ago the retro wave caught me, like so many others and with the internet I found many good resources to start programming in assembly again.

This game is based on a tutorial (see ingame credits page) and my interest in hearing podcasts. It's a thank you to all small podcasters out there who do it for fun, not for money.

216490.overview: Poppy Locky is a game in which the goal is to crack the combination of a lock on a safe. This game was developed by Megastyle and released in 2020.

216494.overview: Peter the postman has to deliver his packages to several houses. The time is limited and so he has to find the best path. Peter can shovel away the snow, but this takes time. Using already cleaned paths is faster. You can move Peter with the Joystick in Port 2. Press the fire button to ring the bell and deliver the package.

216495.overview: A single-player 2D RPG adventure game created by Martin Roscher & Wilfried Elmenreich for Global Game Jam 2021. Peyha - The King is an oldschool mini RPG made to run on the Commodore 64. Jia has an urgent message for the King, but encounters roadblocks every step of the way.

217129.overview: Planet X is a pinball game made by R. Bower using Olaf Lubeck's Pinball Construction Set. It was released into the public domain as part of PCS Club Disk #37.

217487.overview: Prince of Persia: Tournament Plus is a custom set of levels based on the original DOS Prince of Persia game. It contains 13 cutom levels modified from the original for the C64. This version was created by "the programmer" and converted to the C64 by Starwinddz and released in the Prince of Persia Total Pack. This modded version is combat-heavy with a custom storyline and primarily uses tiny levels with altered graphics and audio.

217906.overview: The aim of the game is to stun enemies with paint balls and then eat them. When you have gained enough weight, all players must step on the switch to open the door to the next level. The player who wins the race to the door first wins the level and gets a bonus. Enjoy 33 challenging levels, eating enemies and gaining enough weight to open the exit.

217943.overview: Not to be confused with Pac-Boy, which was published by Markt & Technik, this is a a homebrew Pac-Man inspired game of a similar name. The game was developed by Helge Åkesson and released into the public domain in 1991.

217944.overview: Despite it's name, this is NOT a simulation of a Pachinko machine, rather it's a pinball game made to look "similar" to a Pachinko machine. The game has up to 4 players alternating turns, and was developed by Donald Richter using Olaf Lubeck's Pinball Construction Kit. It was released in 1991 for free as part of Pcs Club Disk #19.

217945.overview:
Pachyderm Panic is a memory game for children for up to 2 players (alternating turns).  It was developed by Buck Childress, and published in the following:

-   Commodore Power/Play Vol.5 N.2 (April/May 1986)

-   Loadstar #023

218151.overview: “Hey, what's up? Hey, you know Pac-Man. You know the original name for Pac-Man was Puck Man. Not because he looks like a hockey puck. But its Paku Paku which means flap your mouth. But, you know, they thought people would scratch out the "p" and turn it into an "f".  Based on original PacMan map reduced to use 3x3 tiles instead of 8x8. This preserves the aspect ratio, map and scoring of the original game. It was never fully completed and as good as it looks, ghost collision was never fully implemented.

218152.overview: A brain\logic game by Pawel Krol, Timo Buschmann and Thomas Manske of Oxyron. It is a fiendish matching game where you must figure out how to clear all the pieces off by matching them together in sets of two or more. Just don't leave a piece or you will need to start over!

218153.overview: Precision is a game of skill and accuracy! Align your moving ball with the still ball so that it moves directly over it. It's fun and challenging. When your ball merges with the other one you get 1 point. The target ball appears in another location. Get as many before time runs out! Hold the fire button to move 3 times as fast. You start with 99 time. Every 2nd point will give you a 4 time bonus. The game will gradually speed up until 100 points. The game ends if time hits 00, or you happen to score 999 points. coding and design by Iceout. Title picture by Axis.

219119.overview: Penny and Peter are package-delivering posties. Their time is very limited, so they have to be quick and efficient! they can shovel snow out of their way, but this takes time. Using already cleaned paths is much faster. Control the player with the joystick in port 2. Shoveling is automatic when you move over snow, press fire to shovel to the right side. Press fire at a door to ring the bell and deliver the package. In two-player mode, Penny (joystick 1) competes with Peter (joystick 2). Whoever finishes their deliveries first wins the round. Tip to win: let the other one do the shoveling and focus on your deliveries.

219161.overview: An arcade style multi-screen platformer created by Bartlomiej Lidke and Grzegorz Strumiñski and published as a preview in Commodore Scene #16.

219667.overview: A platform shooter created by Saul Cross and Steve Ody and released for the RGCD C64 16KB Cartridge Game Development Competition 2015/2016. Pickle is in a pickle! Rescue all the podlets on each level by pushing them toward home. Avoid the creatures or send them flying with a spitball.

219845.overview: Welcome to the endless depths of the PETSCII Cave! Search for treasure and other secret items... but beware! You are not alone in this massive cave...

219846.overview: Poison is a 1988 joystick driven adventure game for the Commodore 64. It was developed by William M. Shockley and published in Loadstar #55.

219865.overview: Earth in 2283 is Destroyed by an Alien Invasion, A New Fighter Plane was created to Fight back and you are the Lucky Pilot, Fly your New Project FX-64 Plane and Blast Aliens and put out Fires with you Sonic-O Blaster, Rescue Survivors when possible. Good Luck Pilot.

219996.overview:
An unofficial public domain conversion of the ZX Spectrum classic from Ultimate - Play the Game (who most people today know as Rare). This was developed and released into the public domain by Rod & Emu Productions on May 4, 2016.

Game Description: 

Following the events of Knight Lore, where Sabreman got himself rid of the curse of the werewulf, he has been tasked to find the ancient magic Pentagram in the forest. Using his magic wand, Sabreman must find the four parts of the Pentagram and use the water from magic wells to restore them. Once this is done five magic runes must be discovered and placed on the Pentagram to make it his.

Pentagram is the final Sabreman Filmation title by Ultimate Play the Game, the gameplay and the isometric graphics are very similar to Knight Lore and Alien 8, with the addition that Sabreman can hurl magical projectiles at the denizens of the forest. The player must solve environmental puzzles to proceed and uncover objectives.

220009.overview:
Promethean Legacy is a dice-rolling strategy game for the Commodore 64. You have six dice and the number of pips on the sides of each die can be increased (or decreased!). At the start of each game the dice have low numbers on each side, some are even blank. 

Move the cursor over a dice and press fire to pick it up, then you can drag it to an open slot and press fire again to drop it. If the slot is not valid, the dice will return home.

Complete quests by placing qualifying dice into the slots, which will upgrade one or more of the dice involved, or reward you in some other way. The game is won when the five 'monument' quests are completed, which involve placing dice totalling a target amount that increases each time. Try and complete the game in as few turns as possible!

The catch is that you must keep at least one sacred fire burning after each turn. These can be lit by sacrificing a pip on one dice, by building a monument or completing certain other quests. The game is over if the fire runs out and no sacrifice is made or qualifying quest completed.

220092.overview:
I thought about doing a hybrid of pong and breakout. You can play with another player or with your computer, your c64. Destroy all the bricks to go to the next level.
Hit the smileys to get the superball that doesn't bounce and smash where it passes!

220147.overview: Polar Bear is stranded in space! Having found a nearby alien space station on his quest for home, he must now locate the secret underground transporter and collect the 99 krystals needed to operate it. Only then can he escape! Artful aliens, onerous obstacles, and tenacious terminals stand in his way. Will you and his trusted companion Snowball be able to turn the odds in his favor?

278322.overview:
This game is based off the "Plinko" game from the US version of The Price Is Right. 

The player is given 10 flat discs which are released one at a time from the top of the board.  The game board consists of a number of pegs which bounce the disc randomly around. As the disc falls to the bottom, it is impossible to determine where the disc might end up. At the bottom of the board, the disc stop and lands in a money slot, the player can win.

The game was put through 100,000 rounds, and it is theoretically possible to get the top amount from anywhere the disc is dropped from on the board. However, you do have a greater chance of winning money from the middle, but it is also twice as likely that you will get nothing as well. 

The game was released as part of Reset Magazine's 2018 C64 4KB Craptastic Game Coding Competition

279592.overview:
Pablito is a game developed by Roberto Ricioppo using the Sideways SEUCK mod and released by TND in 2016.

You are Pablito, a piece of toast, who is on a mission. You must guide Pablito around the maze and do battle against the enemies, in order to escape the maze to freedom. Can you do it, or will you become burnt toast for breakfast? Good luck.

418164.overview: A single-player Pontoon (Blackjack) game by CascadeGames. It was more than likely an enhanced version of the Cassette 50 game, that was released on the notorious "Disk 50" compilation.

418225.overview: Pluff is a platform game, where the player must search for the coin of power in order to leave the maze. The main character has to go around the place and collect various objects. Three items can be carried simultaneously. Pluff will meet many unfriendly creatures and unpleasant surprises, but he will also find keys for opening doors, wires for making traps and other useful items. Pluff is weaponless, therefore the only way to avoid enemies is proper use of jumping skill. The player has to collect a sufficient number of weights, that after placing them in spots marked with arrows, will rise up a stone giving access to the remaining part of the maze, concealing the coin of power.

418515.overview: A strategy game by Digital Monastery. The Italian peninsula, also known as the garden of Europe, since the fall of Western Roman Empire until its Political reunification in 1861 AD, was a Mosaic of different cultures and states with various forms of government. In this game you'll have to manage one of the most important cities of what one day would be called Italy. I wish you to be a good governor...

418518.overview: Night falls. Mist shrouds the streets, concealing their somber secrets. Even the most innocent of kittens searching for a beloved ball of yarn must obey the treacherous city's rules. A lone streetlamp's glow beckons you to embark on a journey. But remember: cats have only nine lives to live, so use them wisely. The city awaits...

419251.overview:
Punch is a take on the "Pong" genre of games for 1-2 players. However, instead of playing as two paddles, you play two guys wearing boxing gloves and have to "Punch" at the ball to make it go toward the other side, hence the name.

If the ball hits you in the face it's considered a lost ball, but it doesn't result in a point for the second player, like in all Pong games, points are only scored if they pass through the player.

The game was developed by Mark Jordan and published by Commodore themselves in Commodore Power/Play Vol.5 N.1 (February/March 1986),  but also published in Loadstar #21.

419624.overview:
Commodore 64 Port from the original Amiga game by Ocean
Aim of the game is to complete each stage by placing the bricks in the correct order so that the last one falling will be the trigger. You have one try only, if you push the stopper brick you waste your chance to complete the stage. At this point you can only restart the level. By completing each stage you gain a token which allows you to restart just before your last push.

421098.overview: Petaxian is an unreleased playable demo shooter. It is a Galaxian inspired game that uses PETSCII graphics as opposed to traditional sprites.

421114.overview:
A 40 year C64 tribute version of PSSST! Released at ZZAP! LIVE 2023.

Game description:

Growing the best Thyrgodian Megga Chrisanthodil possible is the sole purpose of Robbie the Robot. When insects invade his garden, he has to stop them ruining his work. He has a canister of insect repellent, a smoke-bomb and a startling streamer, each placed on walls at the side of his garden. Each will stun any particular vermin, but you will need to find out exactly what kills what.

As the plant grows, aided by the timely addition of compost bags, leaves will start to shoot outwards. The more leaves there are, the quicker it will grow (a simple incorporation of the concept of photosynthesis being boosted by having more sunlight absorbed), so don't let the bugs near it - those whose programmed movement path takes them towards an existing leaf should be your priority. Once the plant is high enough, it flowers and you move onto another level, where increasingly tough foes are on the prowl.

421868.overview: Poe-Poe-Poe (also known as Poe Adventure) is a text adventure loosely based on the writings of Edgar Allan Poe for the Commodore 64. It was developed by Alan W. Gardner and Jim Menick and published in Loadstar #004.

424207.overview: Popeye is a pinball game based on the classic cartoon of the same name. It was developed by H.S using Olaf Lubeck's Pinball Construction Set and released In 1984.

424863.overview:
Being coded in Finland, this Bomberman clone was something that the dwindling C64 scene was crying out for and Commodore Format magazine jumped on it like a pack of hungry wolves when they heard about it. At the time Jon Wells was also trying to keep the C64 going, and made an arrangement with the coder to distribute the game in the UK and sell across Europe too. 
 
After packaging up a 10 level preview for Commodore Format’s Power Pack and requesting for interest in the game. Jon received a staggering amount with 700 reservation slips received – which was a lot at the time when readers were abandoning the platform rapidly for the likes of the Sony PlayStation.

425030.overview:
The player's task is to sell apple pie to the appearing customers. To do this, you need to take the finished pies from the conveyor belt and deliver them to the customer as quickly as possible. The conveyor belt does not stop so you have to do it quickly, otherwise the apple pie will fall. As you progress, the speed of the conveyor belt increases, and the game ends when the player loses 30 apple pies.

Released as a type-in game in Ahoy! 1987/04 (Issue #40) / no definite name, called "Pieman" in the magazine.

425244.overview: My version of Pong game written fully in Commodore 64 assembler.  This game is either 1 or 2 player game and can be controlled with C64 compatible paddles or joysticks.

425270.overview: An unofficial conversion of the tower defense strategy game from PopCap Games for the C64. This was developed by DrMortalWombat and published by Zzap! 64 in 2023.

425409.overview:
Projekt Prometheus is an Adventure game, developed by Extase and published by Bomico Entertainment Software, which was released in Europe in 1991. Projekt Prometheus is a German text adventure with graphics. It is set in 2012 directly after the explosion of a nuclear plant. The only way to get rid of the radioactivity is to fetch a resource only available in space. Unfortunately the whole crew of the space ship was killed by a plague and only one man, a journalist, remains. He has to figure out the space ship controls and solve puzzles, e.g. dealing with a contaminated command console.

The player communicates with the game by typing in commands with the keyboard and reading the game's text descriptions. However, the player can associate often used orders to the function keys. The icon bar, controlled with the mouse, offers additional functions or notifications, e.g. a compass which is used to leave a room, switching between text and graphics (not available for all rooms) or a mini map of the space ship.

425416.overview:
Written by Peter Caspari for the BASIC 10Liner Contest 2023.
Based on the classic space invaders game.  Destroy all raiders while avoiding guided projectiles from the mother ship at the top of the screen

425440.overview: 2022 C64 4KB Game Coding Competition / a.k.a. "POKE 4K" by Daniel Hotop of Protovision. In the game you avoid and shoot the bubbles to survive.

425476.overview:
Released by Jeroen Gildemacher (Goerp) in the 2020 C64 4KB Game Coding Competition. Plazzle, the Plasma puzzle! 

Switch blocks to restore the moving pattern. Sounds can sometimes help you solve the puzzle but for black levels, that is all that's guiding you! Play all the levels for a high score or play a relaxing random level.

425477.overview:
Took part in the 2020 C64 4KB Game Coding Competition. a mix of Snake and Match 4. 

In this game, you have to get cars of the same colors close to each other to get points. 4 in a line or 4 in a square will get you one step closer to the high score!

I wish you a lot of fun with my first C64 game which is also a demake of my first published game. :0D

Controls:
Up / Down / Left / Right for changing the driving direction
Space for faster driving
Hitting an obstacle / the playground borders for parking cars

443998.overview: Paul's Casino is a single player poker game for the Commodore 64. It was developed by Paul Allen Panks and released into the public domain in 2002

444008.overview:
Phantom: The Mission is a 1-player vertically scrolling shoot 'em up for the Commodore 64. The game was developed by Alex Aris and David Axtell of Radical Software Game Design using the Shoot 'Em Up Construction Kit. The game has five levels in total.

The game was published in Commodore Disk User 1989/03-04.

444274.overview:
STORY

After freeing the Earth from Count Dracula and his vampires in his latest adventure, Brok must return to the planet Hawkland, but discovers that the keys to activate the teleporter that will take him to his ship "Andromeda" parked at the lunar station, have been stolen. by one of the vampire's minions and hidden safely in an old fortress. Some creatures have used the transporter and invaded the lunar station and stolen the gems that fuel the ship "Andromeda" and the navigation sphere.

Brok must recover the scroll containing the transportation keys, the crystal sphere and the energy gems and teleport to the lunar station, in order to return in his ship to the planet Hawkland.

Get the 4 keys that will take you to the teleporter and avoid the enemies you find on your way to recover your ship.

444281.overview:
Crashed on an alien planet! That doesn't happen every day! But it happened again during the last thirty years! Again they contacted you to rescue missing tourists out of the caverns of a strange planet... 

This time it won't be so easy like last time. But this time you have missiles in your backpack...

448026.overview: Party Speedway Extended is a fast-paced multiplayer top-down racing game

448591.overview:
Cops and Robbers is a two-player game originally published in "The Commodore 64 Games Book - 21 Sensational Games." One player controls the cops, while the other controls the robbers. The goal for the cops is to chase and catch the robbers in the city before they escape to their hideout.

The city streets run north to south and east to west. The cops have faster cars but must obey traffic laws, allowing only forward or left turns at intersections, with no right turns or U-turns. The robbers can ignore traffic laws, giving them better maneuverability despite having slower cars.

Players can choose the speed of the game. At its fastest, it becomes a thrilling chase through the streets. Played more slowly, it becomes a game of strategy.

448617.overview: This is a Wizard of Wor clone remade entirely in PETSCII graphics. The game mechanics are very similar to the original, although slight differences are possible.

448716.overview: A computerized version of the old popular kids game of the same name for the Commodore 64. This was developed and published by Popposoft as part of the Commodore 64 Crap Game Compo 2006 (C64CGC)

451607.overview: Prince of Persia: The Hostage of Time is a custom set of levels based on the original DOS Prince of Persia game. It contains 13 custom levels modified from the original for the C64. This version was created by Maurice Kaitofen aka mk1995 and converted to the C64 by Starwindz and released in the Prince of Persia Total Pack. What the author had to say about this game: This is the mod I'm most proud of. The difficulty is rather hard, and you will restart levels a lot. Nonetheless, there is still fun to be had with this mod.

451630.overview:
The original 4D prince was created by Kirill A. Terebilov (Russia) in 1994, 4D Prince of Persia is a solid unofficial version of Jordan Mechner's classic action/adventure that starts off the same as the original version but will stump even action veterans with devious level design and tougher enemies in the later stages.

For the uninitiated: Prince of Persia was a smash hit when it was released in 1990, and is today still regarded as one of the best games ever made. The combination of fluid, lifelike animations, great Arabian-Night storyline, and devious physical traps and puzzles made it a revolutionary game for the time, and very challenging even to expert gamers.

The tortuous difficulty level of this fan made version makes it a perfect game for those who finished the original game and are looking for a real challenge to save the princess. This is the follow up to that game, created buy dsprince with 13 updated\original levels a fitting sequel to the original 4D follow up game. This all was converted for the C64 by Starwindz and released in the Prince of Persia Total Pack.

451637.overview: Prince of Persia: Return to Persia is a custom set of levels based on the original DOS Prince of Persia game. It contains 13 custom levels modified from the original for the C64. This version was created by "LIONKINGSKHALID" and converted to the C64 by Starwinddz and released in the Prince of Persia Total Pack. This modded version gives a very large starting time of 200 minutes and has altered graphics from the original. It is a complete modification and you can tell much time was put into it.

452195.overview:
A fast-paced bidirectional horizontal shooter – and perhaps too fast for some of the armchair scroller fans, but what do I care, I need speed. 

To sweeten the deal, you get infinite continues, nine levels of weapon power-up, built-in trainer modes, portals and respawn points.  So battle your way through a gigantic 32k pixel-wide level to find and destroy the end boss.   

You need to pick up fuel barrels to keep your spaceship afloat.  If you activate both sides of a colour-coded portal, you can reap the benefits of hyperspace and travel instantaneously.  Doors require buttons to be pressed.

452218.overview:
The Penultimate Ninja in "Tsunami Tōsō" a 4K craptastic C64 game by Stein Pedersen (design, code, music), Joachim Barrum (graphics) and Steven Dalton (ideas, R&D). A 2024 Reset64 4KB Craptastic Game Competition entry.

You are the penultimate ninja. As a terrible tsunami wreaks havoc on your village, it is up to you to escape the raging wave. Push the stroller holding your only son up the hill to ensure the survival of your line.

Left : Move down the hill.
Right: Move up the hill and grab hold of the stroller.
Fire (when holding stroller): Let go of stroller.
Fire (when NOT holding the stroller): A quick tap will make you jump. You must jump to get past the stroller.
Hold Fire : punch, hold for longer: power punch
Pro Tip: When holding the stroller, do a quick double-tap on the button to be able to smoothly jump over!

452300.overview: This is a PETSCII version of the well-known game, featuring both PvE and PvP modes.

453293.overview:
A brand new puzzle game based on the popular game from 1990 named Puzznic. 

    The only way to restore the harmony of Arcanis is to solve 100 enchanted puzzles, each more challenging than the last. Brave souls must summon all their wit and determination, for only through these trials can the curse be lifted, and peace returned to the land.

The game is one of those that were made with the TSB (Tuned Simons’ Basic) BASIC extension for the Commodore 64. The aim of the game is to slide shapes of the same shape and colour directly next to each other in increasingly complex positions. This is done by pointing at one while holding down the fire button and moving sideways in either direction. Because of the different platforms, it is also important to take gravity into account when choosing sequences.

The game’s 100 maps of varying difficulty are accompanied by a password system and a map editor, which are explained in detail in the .pdf manuals that come with the game.

453440.overview:
An Isometric horror adventure for your Commodore 64 with many nasty puzzles. 

THE INTERMEDIATE STATE AFTER DEATH

BEWARE OF THE DARKNESS AND FIND A WAY TO BRING PEACE TO YOUR SOUL

CODE AND GFX  : MIKA MISFIT KERÄNEN

MUSIC AND TESTING : 8 BITS HIGH

SPRITES : STEVEN GRAYSON

If you want to buy a physical copy, The Future Was 8 Bit provides a professional tape release.

454475.overview: A Pac-Man style arcade game included in Floopy 64 #03 (12/1986). Yes another PACMAN clone, but there are some differences. In Pucky you have only 3 ghosts to worry about and 2 they are even pretty stupid. They are running around somewhat blind- ly. They don't see you and they do not run away when you ́ve Swallowed a blue pill. So you have all the chances to break the new world record with PUCKY Have Phun with this little PUCKY!!

455686.overview:
Plutonium Terrorists is an unofficial conversion of an old VIC-20 text adventure.

The C64 version was developed by Australia's Barry "Cout" Hart of Cout Games, and released in 2019.

455874.overview: Paper Toss is the new one button game by Codey/Excess and a port of an online game. You can play with a joystick in port 1 or 2 or SPACE on the keyboard. Try to throw the paper balls into the trash can. After 3 points the difficulty will increase more and more. After a failed attempt the game is over. Game will create a file and save the highscores. Press the M key to choose between music and sfx only. Have fun!

456368.overview: Pirates of the Black Seas is a text adventure game created with Loadstar's Quest Writer (Published on Loadstar #77 – created by Jon Mattson).

456385.overview:
SEUCK Compo Entry #1

Guide your flying monster across the valley and do battle against the predators of the valley by firing your weapon at them. Good luck!

456640.overview: A miscellaneous arcade style maze game developed by Bill Root and published in COMPUTE! 1984/07 (Issue #50)

456698.overview: Pair Off is a miscellaneous card game for the Commodore 64. It was developed by Joel Epstein and released as part of Loadstar #056 in 1988.

456699.overview:
Quick, quick, there is a plane crew parachuting down from a damaged airliner into a pine forest and the pilot’s parachute hasn’t opened - only you can save him from crashing into the ground. 

From the book "40 Educational Games for the Commodore 64".

456722.overview:
Try jumping from a helicopter in flight and hitting the target on the ground. Pressing a button once sends you plummeting vertically. Pressing it a second time opens your parachute. You'll then descend more slowly at a 45-degree angle because of the wind pushing you. The longer you wait to open your parachute, the less you'll be thrown off course. But don't wait too long, because below 100 meters, the parachute won't open
 
From the type-in book "Jeux en BASIC sur Commodore 64", also published in aBc Informatique #34.

456757.overview: Pushori is a famous game from the Flash era, developed by Tony Pa.This is my C64 version.

456862.overview: Popeye in Space is based on fake game review printed in "Svet Kompjutera" in April 1990. The idea to make the game came sometime in 2024, but development started for real on January 1st 2025.

456959.overview:
In the small village of Mezzani,
The two protagonists, disguised as Santa Claus and his faithful elf helper, will have to distribute the candies to as many children as possible, avoiding the obstacles that will appear in their path.
Traveling through the whole village in the middle of the fog, the final destination will be the town square where the exhibition of nativity scenes usually takes place.

player 1 - Santa
Player 2 - Elf helper

457068.overview:
Something dark has awakened in the halls of Sharp High School.
A powerful Poltergeist has been unleashed... and chaos spreads like wildfire!

The students have lost their minds and are now locked in a furious book war, throwing encyclopedias, notebooks, and textbooks at each other!

But in the middle of the madness, a most unlikely hero rises — a boy with a pure heart and nerves of steel. His name is... TOSHIBA.

Your mission:
– Put an end to the book war!
– Rescue the schoolgirls scattered throughout the building!
– Eliminate the ghosts, skulls, and demons haunting every room and corridor!

And beware! The creepy school janitor is blocking certain passages.
To move forward, you must sacrifice a life!

Only a true hero can save Sharp High School from complete destruction!
GOOD LUCK, TOSHIBA!

457351.overview: Puzzle is a brand-new sliding puzzle game for the Commodore 64, released in .CRT cartridge format.Rearrange the pieces to complete 7 different puzzles, with up to 5 levels of increasing difficulty!

457537.overview:
The Poison Toad is a simple collect 'em Up for the Commodore 64.

It was developed by Diane Sketchley and published in the UK in Personal Computer News #060 (05.05.1984) and in Spain in Commodore Magazine #05 (07/1984) under the name El Sapo Venenoso.

457887.overview:
Pluton is a French language rather simplistic scrolling shooter which can be best described as a scaled down variant of Scramble.

It was developed by Eric Piot and released in the following:

Hebdogiciel N°106 (25.10.1985) + N°107 (01.11.1985)

458050.overview:
A game Is based on the Williams classic, 'Defender'. The program is capable of displaying up to 24 aliens on screen at once, in addition to the 8 sprites which make up the radar in the bottom border.  
 
Published in Commodore Disk User 1990/03, and later in Your Commodore 1990/09 (Tape #08).

458174.overview:
Pop-Top is a game for the Commodore 64 developed by Tony Brantner, and published in RUN 1990/08-09.

The player controls a cute little clown on the bottom of the screen, and you must "shoot" your hat off your head and break the balloons that float across the screen, while avoiding the fans/stars that also float across the screen, as they will destroy your hat, and cost you a "life". The game is quite forgivable though, because if you complete a level, your hat that you lost is restored.

458972.overview:
Pong-C64 is a one-player only Pong clone for the Commodore 64. It was developed and released by Bardon on March 29, 2021. This was Bardon's first and thus far only Commodore 64 game.

It was made using Garry Kitchen's Gamemaker.

459671.overview: Pub Adventure is a short Z-Machine based text adventure game for the Commodore 64. It was developed by Tom and Robin Edwards, and released in 2021 as part of PunyJam #1. The entire game takes place inside a pub/bar.

459888.overview: The goal is to get to a yarn ball at each level, beating various obstacles. Don't worry if you lose a life: a cat has nine! Moreover, your lifeless bodies can help you to beat levels!

460667.overview:
Pair o' Dice Games is a compilation pack of 2 dice games for the Commodore 64. It was developed by Floyd Kirk and published in Loadstar #179. Both games have 1-2 player support.

These include:

(1) PIG - A two-player game (either against the computer or a second human player), with the first to roll a total of 100 or more points the winner. Roll two dice and add up the numbers, until you decide to stop or a die shows a 1. Á 1 on one die means you lose your count for that turn; a double 1 zeroes your total score. Anytime you show a 1, your turn ends.

(2) GREED - A two-player game (either against the computer or a second human player) lasting ten turns, with the high scorer at the end being the winner. Roll two dice and add up the numbers until (a) you decide to stop and save what you have rolled that turn, or (b) the dice add up to the number of your first roll of that turn. If (b), you lose what you rolled that turn and your turn ends.

460862.overview:
This is a traditional game with a difference. You play it against the computer. The computer knows the rules of the game, but it does not know how to win. At first it makes its moves entirely at random, so you stand a good chance of winning. But, after you have played against it several times, it makes good moves more often and bad moves less often. It learns from its mistakes and takes note of its successes. You may then find it much more difficult to beat it.
This simple game is a fascinating one in its own right. Played against a computer which is capable of learning to improve its play is a somewhat unusual experience. 

Published in the book "The Commodore 64 Games Book - 21 Sensational Games".

461459.overview: Pinball Math is an educational math game for the Commodore 64. It was developed by Marion H. Taylor and released under the dev's own label (Taylormade Software) in 1983.

462466.overview:
Popit! is a public domain C64 game in which the player's goal is to bounce on a trampoline and pop balloons. It was developed by Franksey

The game was released by both the developer and on Jim Green PD Disk #73.

The year of release is not known, more than likely because it was originally released over a BBS.

462730.overview:
P.T. (Playable Teaser) is one of the most discussed games ever made. It was a 2014 interactive teaser for the video game Silent Hills, a cancelled instalment in the Silent Hill series.

You have woken up in room that leads to a strange corridor, which  continuously loops and changes itself. Can you piece together the dark past of this place?

The C64 version of P.T. was heavily inspired by the Gameboy Colour version. It is compatible with PAL (recommended) and NTSC machines.

463395.overview: Pushori's central mechanic is "pushing" (hence the game's name). The player controls a moving tile, and the only direct interaction with the tiles is to push them sideways: in other words, tiles can only be pushed left or right. They cannot be pushed vertically up or down directly. The goal of pushing tiles is to create a vertical alignment of two or more tiles with the same symbol. When this happens, the matching tiles disappear from the grid, and the relative cells will be colored. Each level features a grid of cells, usually red cells.

463790.overview:
Everyone is familiar with the game of poker, at least by reputation. We aim to create a program that allows a single player to be dealt five cards chosen at random from a hypothetical deck, exchange some of them, and have the CBM-64 determine the resulting hand. Our program must be capable of:

■ displaying five face-down cards on the screen
■ revealing the five cards
■ waiting for the player to indicate which cards they wish to exchange
■ replacing the cards discarded by the player
■ evaluating the resulting hand.

If the player wishes, the computer will display a summary of the scores achieved before restarting the program from the beginning. 

Published in the book "20 Programmi per Commodore 64".

463852.overview: Phobia is a 1 player only Seuck game for the Commodore 64. It was developed by Claudio Mazzuco and published by Systems Editoriale in an unknown year.

463870.overview:
The sequel to Phobia!, also developed by Claudio Mazzuco and published by Systems Editoriale.

However unlike the first game, the sequel does have 1-2 player co op play.

466569.overview: Help PulcinoPulcino, a small blue chick, find the 3 pieces of the key to put together in order to try to get out of this labyrinth. Don’t touch the walls and be careful, the walls will open and close in front of you!

471188.overview:
Probe-X: Planet Osmium is a 1-2 player co-operative shooter for the Commodore 64. It was developed by Pixol and Hawk-I using the Shoot 'em Up Construction Kit and released in 1990.

It was followed up by a sequel which was titled Probe-Y: Planet Media in 1991.

472572.overview: Pharaoh's Legacy is the sequel to Rise of Babylon. Once again, the goal is to utilize limited space to build the most efficient city possible. However, this time there are even more building options available and additional aspects included, such as constructing a pyramid and building a legacy. Furthermore, the game now features a multiplayer mode for up to four players.

472902.overview: PONG captures the essence of the first arcade video games with an authentic retro aesthetic for the Commodore 64.

473571.overview: A Commodore 64 Adventure The world has gotten weird, and only one gardener is equipped to clean it up. Play as Petal Pete in a stunning new C64 platformer that mixes tight arcade action with frantic flora-growing mechanics. Navigate through multi-stage worlds, outsmart bizarre enemies, and face off against screen-filling bosses by planting seeds, sprouting platforms, and fighting back with the power of nature. Remember the golden rule: Plant fast! Fight weird!

474410.overview: Help Princess Amelia collect the "Letter Shields" that spell her name.

476657.overview: You’ve got 10 weekends to hit the city’s biggest parks and festivals, sell lemonade like your rent depends on it, and bank as much cash as you can. Stock up. Set your price. Watch the weather. Squeeze every thirsty crowd for all they’re worth.

476828.overview: It is a room-based bullet hell roguelike set inside a mysterious alien ship. The player explores unstable rooms, fights enemies, destroys crates, collects useful items, opens doors and searches for the powerful Gorkers hidden inside the ship.

478459.overview:
Paper Route is a single-player game in which you play a poper boy on a bike, and must deliver newspapers to houses, similar in some ways to the arcade classic Paperboy, except you drive the bike  horizontally instead of vertically.

The game was developed by Bob Blackmer and published as a type-in listing in Ahoy! 1987/11 (Issue #47).

478552.overview: Phonics Fun One is an educational software title from Grolier / Mindflight that was recently recovered from long-term archival loss in August 2026

478557.overview: Phonics Fun Two is an educational software title from Grolier / Mindflight that was recently recovered from long-term archival loss in August 2026

480186.overview:
Pizza Boy by Cleveland M. Blakemore

A conversion to the C64 of a type-in program for the C128 originally published in the December 1987 issue of Ahoy magazine.

Here's Cleve to tell you about the game:

You can't decide which is worse about your new job as pizza boy: your whining boss or the city that you deliver in. Between speeding motorists and rabid mongrels, it seems like your wages are ridiculously low. Worst of all, the delivery boy has to pay the difference if a pizza shows up cold.

Pizza Boy is a fun, fast action game. You'll need a joystick plugged into Port 2 to play.

After the title screen, you'll be presented with a city map, in which the pizza restaurant is located in the upper left comer. The restaurant area contains a window displaying how much money you've made, a block for the three lives you start out with, and the pizza counter beneath. Your boss is the grimacing fellow behind the counter; he sits next to the telephone and takes orders.

When an order is called in, the hungry caller lights up inside the house of origin, with a ravenous look on his face as he sits before an empty plate with knife and fork.

The boss will place a pizza under the heat lamps after taking the caller's order, awaiting your pickup and delivery. To pick up a pizza, merely stand under the heat lamp, close to it, and press the fire button. The pizza will vanish, meaning you are now carrying it.

Every time a pizza is placed under the heat lamp, the pizza boy's figure will light up with a color representing the temperature of the pizza. He starts out a steaming yellow, but will cycle through light red-dark red-brown-blue-black, to indicate the temperature of the pizza as it cools.

As long as the pizza is under the heat lamp, it cools slowly. Once you have it in your possession, it will cool very rapidly, so get it to the caller as quickly as possible. A regular pizza costs $20, but the customer may tip if it is warmer than expected, and he will certainly deduct from the base price as it grows colder. How much profit you make depends on the speed with which you arrive with the caller's pizza.

As if this weren't difficult enough already, you have to dodge the automobiles in town and watch out for the mad dog as you race through the streets. Once you arrive at a customer's house, go through the door and touch him to get your money. Immediately, another caller phones in, and a pizza is sitting under the heat lamps back in the restaurant, getting frosty while you hurry back.

If you get struck by a car or bitten, you lose one pizza boy. If you allow a pizza to grow completely cold, you'll also lose a boy.

Every time you successfully deliver five pizzas, the cars will pick up the pace a little. It gets pretty lough to navigate the city after 10 pizzas. If you manage to make anything over $100 in profit, you're a natural.

480258.overview: A top-down Commodore 64 game. You sail a black pirate galleon through a randomly generated archipelago of sandy islands, hunting a treasure ship for her gold while the Royal Navy patrols the sea around you. She turns to face whichever way you steer her, and shoots the way she is sailing.

480335.overview: A SEUCK based shooter created by Stephen Day & Janno Christopher in 1988. The game supports cooperative play.

480744.overview:
Tossed into the PETSCII Pit, you, a young @ symbol, must navigate a tediously slowly procedurally generated, turn-based labyrinth rendered using the Commodore 64 PETSCII character set, written entirely in C64 BASIC.
Can you uncover its secrets and escape?

480781.overview: Poem pong is a pong game combined with funny poems. Remove the barriers to see the poem. If you lose a ball the game is over and you have to start from the beginning again. Play with a joystick in port 2. This game is written in assembler and coded for the one hour game jam 512 themed poem. Press c= key to get back to the game menu.

480797.overview: The first in a series of five Boulder Dash games by the German group Posocopi Waldkirch. It uses the PLCK engine and has 20 caves to solve and pillage.

480887.overview: A pyramid game in ancient Egypt for the Commodore 64!

481065.overview: You decide to return to the high seas again. Why retire when the gold is still flowing? However, the stakes are higher now. The Royal Navy will continue to pursue you but be warned if you stir the waters up too much with cannon fire you just just might awaken something far worse. Never fear though as mermaids will assist you along the way. Survive long enough and you can upgrade your ship via a gift from King Neptune.

481401.overview: Build a frame of face cards around the 4×4 tableau in this simple, challenging solitaire game. Deal from the deck to fill the spots, pip cards anywhere, Jacks on the sides, Queens on the top and bottom, and Kings in the corners.

481674.overview: You are Pogo Bot, a little robot on a spring. You can't walk. You bounce. Hop across platforms, squash the local wildlife and collect every diamond on the screen to open the way to the next level.

481951.overview: You'll know the 1980 arcade classic where cities wait for the end under a sky full of falling missiles. Planet Command moves that last stand into orbit. Each world floats in the middle of the screen, and missiles streak in from every direction. Your single gun turret circles the planet's surface, spinning round to meet each threat and firing outward into the dark.

481956.overview: A free pinball machine for the Commodore 64 Ultimate and the Commodore 77 Ultimate.

481975.overview:
One track, a trail of pellets and a ghost… who needs a maze to get into trouble?

Move left or right and eat every pellet to reach the next level. Grab the power pellet to make the ghost vulnerable and turn the tables! Both ends of the track connect, giving you another way to escape.

482074.overview: Drive down an endless road full of potholes. Jump over them, collect coins, run over traffic cones for extra points and see how long you can survive.

482202.overview:
An unofficial port of the C16/Plus 4 game of the same name. The C64 port was developed by Firefox.

Game Description:

Pin Point is based on the game Spindizzy where you control a spinning top over ten flick-screen isometric levels to reach a white flag. Each level is a route of platforms and you must guide the top without falling of the edges within a time limit. If you fall of the edge then you start at the beginning of the level wasting valuable time. You must be aware of the inertia of the top as it will keep moving after moving downhill so the joystick will need pressing in the opposite direction. To get up some hills or clear gaps you can give a little burst of speed by pressing the fire button.

482542.overview:
An official port of the Windows Steam game of the same name for the C64, developed and published by the same devs and publisher as the PC version.

Description:

Celebrate the end of 2020--the Year of Poop--with this bizarre throwback to second-generation video games of the early 1980s!

Joggers are happily trotting across the local park in an effort to reach their fitness goals. But--armed with the healthiest metabolism the world has ever seen--you're going to put a stop to that.

Make your way across the park and poop everywhere. Little poops will only slow the joggers down, but keep pooping to increase poop size. When a jogger hits a large poop, they'll be stopped for good and you'll score a point! If you run out of fuel, simply go back to the starting point alongside the taco restaurant and eat. Then you'll be ready for more!

In this love letter to old console games from the early 80s, you'll enjoy unique, one-button, fast-paced action that only gets faster! The action is paired with classic-style visuals and authentic sound effects created with Korg synthesizer software. With two difficulty levels, and Time Attack mode, you'll chase high scores across 4 Steam Leaderboards. Available DLC adds three unique new rulesets and 12 more Leaderboards! There's a set of Achievements too!

The joggers will come faster and in greater numbers, but you'll be ready. This time is going to be different. Look out, joggers...you're going to have a crappy day.

482562.overview: The club is packed, the DJ is spinning and the mirror ball is turning. Lead the polonaise across the dance floor, touch the guests and they join the end of the line. But watch out for the furniture, the walls and your own tail!

482590.overview: Poor Mr. Pumpkin is tossed into the air and can only bounce on the block of the same color: move the six-color bar with the A and D keys and keep it under the pumpkin. Every correct bounce is worth one point, but one wrong color and the pumpkin falls, ending the game. Your best score is kept as BEST.

482599.overview: You play as private eye Bob, a little man with a huge hat and a gun, out to settle the score with goons and rescue the dame in distress.

482767.overview: Land the HEX 32 lander on 10 worlds of the solar system – a colourful real-time C64 lander game with SID music!

482830.overview: The assault on the Oathbreaker’s Tower has failed. But you’ve been given a second chance. Fight your way back to the top, uncover the tower’s secrets, and master the spells you’ll need to defeat the Warlock of Pitchstone Tower.

482886.overview: PLATOON OF HEROES is a top-down war game written from scratch for the Commodore 64 by APIX.

482946.overview:
Not to be confused with the official arcade port of the arcade game of the same name, this game, which obviously borrows it's name from Namco's arcade classic, is actually a German-language top-down racing game.

It was developed by Stephan Pabst and published in Homecomputer 1986/04-05.
